ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
If the letters of the Word MAMA are written underneath each other then the word has a vertical axis of symmetry. For which of these words does that also hold true?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the image, the uppercase letters of the word MAMA are arranged vertically, one below another, and there is a vertical dashed line in the middle passing through the center of each letter. It can be seen that the letters M, A, M, A are all left-right symmetric about this vertical center line in this uppercase style. Then reason: For a vertically written word to have a vertical axis of symmetry, each letter itself needs to be symmetric about the same vertical center line. Check TOTO: The letter T has a vertical axis of symmetry, and the letter O also has a vertical axis of symmetry; the later T and O likewise satisfy this. Therefore, TOTO also has a vertical axis of symmetry when written vertically.

method.method_draft: Use a per-letter symmetry test. From the image, note that MAMA is written vertically with a dashed vertical line passing through the center of each uppercase letter, so the stacked word is symmetric only if every letter in the word is itself vertically symmetric in the displayed block-capital style. From the text, identify that we need another word satisfying the same condition. Test the candidate word TOTO: T has a vertical line of symmetry, O has a vertical line of symmetry, then T and O again also do. Since every letter in TOTO is vertically symmetric when stacked on the same centerline, fill the blank with TOTO.

method.method_draft: Use a whole-shape mirror reflection check. From the image, interpret the dashed line as a mirror: reflecting the entire vertical stack M-A-M-A across that line leaves the stack unchanged. From the text, seek a word whose vertically written form would also be unchanged by this mirror operation. Write TOTO mentally underneath itself along a common centerline. Reflect the full stack across the vertical centerline: the top T maps to itself, each O maps to itself, and the bottom T maps to itself, so the complete vertical word remains identical. Therefore the blank is TOTO.
method.CoT_raw:
Image description: The image shows the letters M, A, M, A written one underneath another. A dashed vertical line runs through the center of the whole vertical stack, acting like a mirror line. Each letter in MAMA is centered on this line and is unchanged by reflection across it.

Reasoning: Using the same whole-shape mirror reflection check, we need a word that stays unchanged when its letters are written vertically and reflected across a common vertical centerline. For TOTO written vertically, T, O, T, O each has vertical symmetry when centered on the same line. Reflecting the full vertical stack across that line leaves every letter and the whole word unchanged. Therefore the blank is TOTO.
